label: REAL
summary: v1.1.0: plan -> observe -> advise -> apply -> adapt, runtime orchestration (native/Ollama/vLLM), and a product-grade CLI. Additive over v1.0.0.
semver_rationale: Minor: no frozen contract (API v1, CLI contract, --json shapes) is broken; new subcommands/flags/fields and two optional server.json blocks are additive; human-readable wording is explicitly not frozen.

K_adaptive_runtime.evidence: PR #91 squash-merged (b818809); test_adaptive/test_adaptive_controller/test_adaptive_cmd; controller under TSan; CI all green. Pressure behavior validated by a deterministic synthetic timeline only (SYNTHETIC)

real_upgrade_test.label: REAL
real_upgrade_test.result: A copy of a real v1.0.0 registry and server.json were left byte-IDENTICAL after 13 read-only v1.1.0 commands (dashboard, models, plan, observe, advise, apply dry run, adaptive status, run --explain, doctor, status, model list); no audit log was created. Done with the build-tree binary, not a container.

security.mutation_surfaces: loopback admin routes reached through membrane apply, which is dry-run by default

known_limitations: Adaptive pressure handling is validated by a deterministic synthetic timeline, not by inducing real memory pressure on hardware
Ollama and vLLM were tested against mock servers following audited API shapes; no live daemon was run
No multi-GPU execution and no distributed orchestration: topology and device visibility only
Settings other than context (KV precision/placement, GPU layers) take effect at the next model load; the controller never reloads a model on its own
The full local ctest was not run on the 5.6 GiB development host; CI ran the full suite
New catalog families are metadata-only (never run by MEMBRANE) except where labeled otherwise
No official Windows or macOS package; independent multi-host validation remains limited
No tool calling, no /v1/embeddings, no response_format beyond text
